audit_items.proof_trace: Config loading validates MaxBlobsPerBlock > math.MaxUint32 but never checks MaxBlobsPerBlock <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK (4096). Runtime validation uses unconstrained BlobSchedule values, allowing consensus split.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker provides config with BLOB_SCHEDULE entry having MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK > 4096. Node accepts blocks with excessive blobs via P2P while spec-compliant nodes reject them, causing consensus failure.
